about: Version 2 of Fifteen Days, the GPT cut (owner, 2026-10-18: "Chat gpt version is so much better. Let's go with that one and change the site to allow closed models"; the cut as is). Version 1's cut with every model-drawn picture redrawn by GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (OpenAI), a closed model; the words, voices, sound, timing, mix and the pictures drawn in code are version 1's. Inputs open, model closed: the prompts, the reference pictures sent (by sha256), the scripts and every call's recipe and cost are committed; the model's weights are not published by its maker. Its files are on the branch scenes-sound (cc9590d) until it is merged.
title: Fifteen Days
made_from: version 1's picture recipes (adaptations/fifteen-days/versions/1.json), one GPT picture per picture in cut v6

poster.what: the triptych (owner's pick A, 2026-10-18): the GPT close-ups cov-gate-CU-Z-smile-K7-g1, cov-corridor-CU-B-sour-K9-g1 and cov-cafe-CU-D-warm-E16-g2, each cropped to a 632×850 panel around the face, 12 px gaps, over a 230 px cream title bar: 'Fifteen Days' (Crimson Pro 600, 150 px) and 'BASED ON VITALIK / BUTERIN’S SNOWMOON' (DM Mono 26 px), the share image's words; 1920×1080 JPEG, quality 90, made with Pillow

poster_shown.why: The home card prints 'Fifteen Days' under the poster, so the titled triptych doubled the title (owner, 2026-10-18: 'Probably best if starting image is just the 3 of them no text'). A published version's recipe is fixed (0012: only hidden can change), so the recipe keeps naming "poster" and the site shows this one in its place (src/lib/scene-delivery.ts), as it does the delivery copies.
poster_shown.what: the same three GPT close-ups as "poster" (keyart 1536×864 masters of cov-gate-CU-Z-smile-K7-g1, cov-corridor-CU-B-sour-K9-g1 and cov-cafe-CU-D-warm-E16-g2), each cropped to its full height and 506 px wide around the face (centres 0.48, 0.48, 0.52 of the width), scaled to a 632×1080 panel (Lanczos), 12 px cream gaps, no text; 1920×1080 JPEG, quality 90, made with Pillow

editor.why: The live editor and Remix read a version's committed pictures and recipes (scripts/editor-data.mjs). Version 2's pictures are not committed on main, so the editor stays on version 1's shots for now, and says so.

delivery.about: The same cut, packaged to start sooner, as version 1's (src/lib/scene-delivery.ts); made in the scenes checkout and uploaded by npm run publish:scene-video -- --version 2.

wide.same_as_cut: video and audio streams bit-identical (ffmpeg -f streamhash: video 8c7343e0…, audio 829cca4c…, the same audio as version 1)

phone.made: ffmpeg -i coverage-v6-gpt.mp4 -map 0 -vf scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -preset slow -crf 24 -maxrate 900k -bufsize 1800k -g 60 -keyint_min 30 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy, with the same fragment flags as wide (ffmpeg 9.0.1)
phone.video_rate: 0.76 Mb/s measured from its packets (the stream header's 1.49 Mb/s is a figure fragmented files report wrongly)
